summary: [Slack] idempotency: No native idempotency-key on chat.postMessage in retrieved docs. Client-side pattern: (channel, ts) is the stable identity: record ts from a successful post; on timeout, read recent history to check the post landed before re-posting. Event deliveries dedupe by event_id via X-Slack-Retry-Num. Native guidance UNVERIFIED in this pass.
followup: Verify current Slack idempotency guidance (docs.slack.dev rate-limits/idempotency) at build time.
